title.original: VISTA: A Versatile Interactive User Simulation Toolkit for Agent Evaluation
title.zh: VISTA：面向智能体评测的通用交互式用户模拟工具包
title.en: VISTA: A Versatile Interactive User Simulation Toolkit for Agent Evaluation

inclusion_reason.zh: VISTA 的 UI/API 混合用户模拟器、环境适配层和六指标分析可复用于多类交互 Agent 的动态评测。
inclusion_reason.en: VISTA's hybrid UI/API user simulator, environment adapters, and six-metric analysis are reusable across dynamic evaluations of interactive agents.

abstract.zh: VISTA 是交互式用户模拟评测工具包，联合 UI 与 API 行为，并以六类指标检查模拟交互的真实度、能力覆盖和有效性。
abstract.en: VISTA is an interactive user-simulation toolkit combining UI and API behavior with six metrics for realism, capability coverage, and interaction effectiveness.

problem.zh: 静态基准无法暴露动态多步失败，而现有用户模拟器既缺自身质量度量，又通常被限制在纯 UI 或纯 API 行为。
problem.en: Static benchmarks miss dynamic multi-step failures, while existing user simulators lack quality measures and are usually restricted to either UI-only or API-only actions.

approach.zh: 作者构建混合用户模拟器，在一次交互中切换 UI 和 API 动作，并从真实性、覆盖范围和交互效果等维度评估生成轨迹。
approach.en: A hybrid user simulator switches between UI and API actions within an interaction, and generated traces are scored for realism, coverage, and effectiveness.

system_design.zh: 工具包包括用户目标与画像、双通道动作执行器、环境适配层、轨迹采集和六指标分析面板，可接入不同 Agent。
system_design.en: The toolkit combines user goals and personas, dual-channel action execution, environment adapters, trace capture, and a six-metric analysis layer for different agents.

key_results.zh: 在电商购物和教育客服中，VISTA 比既有方法产生更真实且覆盖更全面的交互式评测。
key_results.en: In e-commerce shopping and education support, VISTA produces more realistic and comprehensive interactive evaluations than existing approaches.

limitations.zh: 两类应用不足以覆盖高风险人机协作，六指标仍依赖操作化定义；模拟用户无法替代真实用户的长期目标、情绪和责任。
limitations.en: Two application settings do not cover high-risk human-agent collaboration, the six metrics depend on operational definitions, and simulation cannot replace real users' long-term goals and accountability.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 标签仅来自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未给出可安全转录的表格级数值、硬件与集群配置，相关细节仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation labels above come only from the official arXiv abstract; it provides no table-level numbers, hardware, or cluster configuration safe to transcribe, so those details await full-text audit.
